versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "thinking-fast-and-slow" decision support skill.
- Provides core frameworks and cognitive biases from 《思考，快与慢》 to aid in better decision-making.
- Users receive context-based references to relevant concepts (e.g. 双系统模型, 损失厌恶, 框架效应) with explanations and actionable advice.
- Designed for quick identification of biases and use of Kahneman’s mental models in daily choices.
